protocol.scope: One exploratory alternative on four PINNS sites examined in earlier work. One fixed coefficient fit per held-out site, no validation or tuning.
protocol.windows: Five complete observations (0.4 s span), then 30 complete targets (3.0 s). Within each clip/person, split at missing or nonfinite frames and take consecutive, disjoint 35-frame blocks from each run's start. Drop short remainders.
protocol.coordinates: Annotated pedestrian ground positions in metres, downsampled from 30 to 10 Hz without interpolation, with the project's calibration-based Y orientation.
protocol.forecast: C[t] = t * (last position - penultimate position), t=1..30, relative to the last observation. Compare a*C to C.
protocol.fit: Minimize squared 2D position errors with no intercept. a = clip(sum_s mean_windows,steps(C dot Y) / sum_s mean_windows,steps(C dot C), 0, 1), using the three training sites only.
protocol.metrics: ADE is the mean Euclidean position error at steps 1..30; FDE is the Euclidean error at 3.0 s. Macro gives each held-out site equal weight. Negative deltas mean lower errors.

verification.coefficient_inputs: fit_scale receives only the three arrays named in train_site_windows. The held-out array is read for evaluation after fitting.
verification.baseline_checked: Counts and unscaled ADE/FDE from all four folds plus the macro ADE/FDE; tolerance 1e-10 m.
